axis: loose supposition → belief firm enough to accuse

members.tone: Belief pointed at a person and against them — where *think* merely holds a view, this one holds someone guilty.
The plain, unmarked way to hold something to be so, without the hedge of *suppose* or the formality of *opine*.
Holds the belief provisionally, as something granted rather than asserted outright the way *think* asserts it.
Informal and flatly settled — states the expectation as arrived at, with none of the tentativeness of *suppose*.
Reaches the belief by picturing how things must be, so it sounds more speculative than *think* even when it means the same.
The most offhand of these, conceding that the expectation rests on little where *reckon* sounds decided.
Formal, and it frames the belief as an opinion delivered rather than a thought privately held as with *think*.
